adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Decoded/present counters stay at zero; only real FFmpeg output/successful Present feed them

adversarialCases.scenario: Pause active at ConnectionComplete (minimize during connect/reconnect)
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Pause survives dog.start; no escalation while minimized

adversarialCases.scenario: Stall latch recorded under a stale generation polled after restart
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Stale latch dropped at poll; generation reflects the real session lease

adversarialCases.scenario: Repeated present stalls; recreate failures; recovery mid-ladder
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Bounded recreates (3) then R8/egui fallback reachable under default tuning (present_max_attempts=4) before Reconnect; success resets
Every field round-trips with live values including lease generation
